rows.name: database
rows.summary: The Postgres database: why Postgres was chosen, raw-SQL data access with no ORM, and the migration runner in src/db/migrate.ts.
rows.readWhen: Writing or changing migrations, adding tables or queries, touching src/db/, or proposing a different database or query library.
conventions: Postgres is the database (ADR 0001); don't add another datastore without a new decision record.
No ORM (ADR 0003): write queries as plain SQL.
Every migration must be reversible: ship the down step with the up step.

boxes.name: migration-runner
boxes.summary: src/db/migrate.ts exports migrate(), the entry point that applies database migrations. It is currently a 2-line stub.
boxes.readWhen: Running, adding, or rolling back migrations, or changing how migrate() finds and applies them.

rows.name: feature-flags
rows.summary: Feature flags, which live in the config service (ADR 0002), and how long a flag may stay after rollout.
rows.readWhen: Adding, reading, rolling out, or removing a feature flag, or changing where flags are stored.
conventions: Flags are defined and read through the config service, not hard-coded or kept in env files.
Remove a flag within two releases of its full rollout.
